newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Crossair founds new airline with French.
newsitem.headline: Crossair founds new airline with French.

text.p: Crossair AG said it was working with French investors to found a new airline that would be based at the Basle-Mulhouse airport, EuroAirport.
Crossair, a subsidiary of SAirGroup, said it had founded and registered a company, European Continental Airways (ECA), in January.
Crossair has a stake of 35 percent in ECA's initial "minimal share capital," Crossair said in its 1996 annual report.
The project, however, is not yet ripe for final decisions as various market surveys are being conducted and permissions are being obtained, the report added.
